subtopic: Mutual Funds and Annuities in Retirement Plans
source_evidence: Typically, 403(b) and 457(b) plans offer two types of investment products – mutual funds and annuities.
answer: 403(b) and 457(b) plans typically offer mutual funds and annuities as investment options. A mutual fund share is a security regulated by the SEC. An annuity is a contract with an insurance company; depending on its type, it may be regulated by state insurance commissions, the SEC, or both.
